hypothesis: Independent hypothesis: recent ETH total-supply contraction predicts higher subsequent ETH returns than expansion. Not pure fee burn, causal identification, a paper replication, or established alpha.
basis: Prior official input review supports the observable total-supply stock, not predictive profitability. Weekly horizon is an a priori aggregation choice, not selected from returns.

calendar.reason: Three complete calendar years after the Merge; final exit 2026-01-05T12:00:00Z. No optimized start date or rolling extension.

supply.direction: long if new < old; short if new > old; equality excluded
supply.units: native ETH stock; compare Decimal values without rounding, fitting or magnitude thresholds
forbidden_substitutes: IssTotNtv minus supply change labeled fee burn

availability.rule: All eight fixed daily observations must have both completion timestamps >= their period end and <= decision; maximum completion across all fields/rows must be <= decision. Completion after retrieval is invalid. No nearest-available fallback or delayed entry.
availability.missing: Missing/null supply or clock excludes the whole fixed week before capacity/outcome computation; zero is not a missing-value substitute. Malformed, duplicate, wrong-identity or nonfinite data is a technical stop.
availability.revision: Bind one immutable retrieval/raw hash manifest. Never refresh individual losing weeks or splice versions. A known historical revision or unbound accounting break blocks economic use pending input review; unknown historical vintages remain explicitly unknown.
availability.limitation: Recorded completion is not first publication. Retrospective exclusion can itself be revision-biased. Even a negative screen only rejects this fixed reconstructed-data rule, not every possible PIT strategy.

price_control.direction: momentum: long if new price > old price, short if new < old, equality excludes common week
price_control.old_time: 00:00 UTC at end of old supply day
price_control.new_time: 00:00 UTC at end of new supply day
price_control.field: Bybit ETHUSDT linear trade hourly open
price_control.purpose: Same preceding seven-day price direction; not an oracle or a causal demand control

capacity.reason: Predeclared coverage/diversity floors, not a statistical-power guarantee; no new dates, fallback assets or threshold changes if any floor fails.

required_before_capacity: pin source/metric definition and daily boundary
free catalogue and actual full requested coverage receipts
explain total supply accounting across protocol upgrades without double counting deposits/withdrawals
record known revisions/method changes; unresolved definition break stops, not price-based exclusion
confirm permitted research use before acquisition; public access is not commercial permission

market.funding_rule: Verify historical schedule and complete actual events; never assume a missing funding record equals zero. Schedule uncertainty stops input acceptance.

cost.basis: Fixed conservative reference assumptions, not verified account tier or executed liquidity. Cannot lower them after results.
cost.funding: Actual historical signed rate times signed ETH quantity times mark price at each timestamp; entry <= t < exit. Apply identically to controls.

economy.entry_exit: Scheduled hourly trade open plus adverse 5bps on both legs; full exit then re-entry even if direction repeats; no netting saved costs.
economy.quantity: 25% of pre-entry strategy reference NAV divided by slipped entry price; constant ETH quantity for seven days; signed direction; reinvest only at next fixed entry.
economy.reference: Initial NAV 1, no borrowing, interest or staking income; no account PnL claim. Missing weeks are flat with zero return on the full calendar.
economy.risk: Mark OHLC equity bounds include cumulative fees/funding and hypothetical exit cost. Definite drawdown lower bound >=8% is REJECT; upper-only breach is INSUFFICIENT_RISK_ORDER. Stop immediately before later outcomes/statistics. Do not invent an intrabar stop fill.
controls: preceding-seven-day ETH price momentum, same eligible weeks/costs
economy.control_comparison: Unit-entry-notional paired net returns; descriptive standalone control paths never govern strategy quantity or skip strategy risk. No control outcomes after a strategy risk stop.
economy.statistic: Valid-week mean unit-notional net return and paired differences to both controls; excluded slots stay on calendar as null, not packed together for resampling.

bootstrap.type: circular moving-block calendar weeks; exclude nulls only within each statistic
bootstrap.family: three one-sided bounds, Bonferroni 5% within this contract only; does not repair prior route-selection bias

economy.positive_requirements: Complete path, no risk stop, all three lower bounds >0, and positive mean net in both fixed calendar halves. An empty resampled statistic yields INSUFFICIENT_STATISTICS, not redraw.
economy.otherwise: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; definite strategy risk breach is REJECT_FIXED_RULE. No sign reversal, window/cost/allocation change or second experiment.

audit.before_outcomes: Freeze raw/normalized hashes, code, contract, actual data exclusions/cell counts and authorization record; atomically reserve the sole economic attempt before reading outcomes. A technical crash is not a new experiment allowance.
independent_checks: Decimal cash/fee/funding reconstruction independent of main return helper
common input clock and price-control timestamps
all excluded slots and four capacity cells
raw receipt/code/contract identity and complete calendar

sequence: source coverage and capacity without forward outcomes
future_batch_proposal_not_authorized.request_estimate: About 2 supply pages + 54 hourly trade/mark pages + 17 funding pages (8h schedule only as a sizing assumption) =73; up to12 official review reads plus35 reserve fit120. Recalculate actual schedule/pages within cap before acquisition; no automatic extension.
future_batch_proposal_not_authorized.expected_input_exit: INPUT_INSUFFICIENT or CAPACITY_INSUFFICIENT closes batch with zero economic attempts
future_batch_proposal_not_authorized.technical_failure: Stop dependencies; diagnose/root-cause/path review; at most one exact-command gate retry after confirmed cause. No bypass state or automatic new economic attempt.
future_batch_proposal_not_authorized.qualification: No G1/Demo/live/learning activation. A promising result needs independent unseen evidence and version/usage audits under a new substantive decision.
